conditions.G: single-state event lifecycle: keep except explicit runtime correction reset
conditions.M: two-bank semantic routing: runtime=A, security=B; reset only affected runtime bank at correction
conditions.X: two-bank shuffled cross-domain grouping control with same two-bank storage, active compute, and one reset

execution.condition_parallelism: five independent GitHub Actions matrix jobs
execution.within_condition: six episodes execute sequentially in one process/state lineage
execution.aggregation: deterministic result-only job after all five shards

classifier.SUPPORTED: M has higher aggregate hard correctness than X, no task-completion regression, no hard regression on either lane-return episode 5 or 6, and is not worse than G in aggregate hard correctness.
classifier.MIXED: M and X tie on aggregate hard correctness with positive M-X margin sum and positive M-X margins on both episodes 5 and 6, or M has a hard primary gain with a secondary tradeoff.

claim_boundary: Exact scale replication only. A 2.9B result may test whether the P-R2-01 routing signal is scale-stable or converts to hard correctness; it does not establish universal multi-state superiority or a production architecture.
